DISTANT LIGHTNING — a distant fork of lightning splitting the dark sky behind dense violet lavender beds, the drenched purple spires lit for an instant
RAINBOW OVER BEDS — a soft rainbow arcing over overflowing rose beds as rain eases, the lush crimson and cream blooms glowing beneath the coloured arch
HAIL SCATTER — small hailstones bouncing among packed indigo delphiniums and white peonies, the abundant blooms shivering under sudden ice, petals jewelled with drops
WIND-GUST WAVE — a storm-wind gust flattening dense blue hydrangea masses in a rolling wave, petals and spray lifting off the overflowing beds in layers
GROUND MIST RISING — warm ground mist rising after the shower through tiered layers of lush purple coneflowers and cerise dahlias, the crisp colored blooms steaming softly
SUN-SHOWER — rain falling through bright sun over a monumental wall of blue delphiniums, each drop lit gold, the dense violet spires flashing in the sun-shower
DOWNPOUR TO STEAM — a downpour easing as a shaft of warm sun strikes lush magenta and white cosmos beds, petals heavy with water, crisp colored layers receding beyond
GROUND MIST — mist rising off warm wet earth between layers of rose and violet blooms, the crisp clear air above glowing with returning warm light
DOWNPOUR EASING — a downpour softening to clear warm air over packed beds of white ranunculus and deep-violet salvia, every layered bloom crisply lit and richly colored
